## Language and communication

- Write all user-facing text in Vietnamese, including issue comments, pull request titles and descriptions, commit messages, explanations, and documentation.
- Use natural, fluent Vietnamese that is easy for native Vietnamese speakers to understand.
- Keep programming language keywords, code identifiers, API names, filenames, and technical terms in English when appropriate.
- Do not translate existing English text unless explicitly requested.
- If a task requires communication in another language, follow the language explicitly requested for that task.
